name: Cream of Wheat Original Hot Cereal (Smooth Farina)
whyItWorks: Fine wheat farina with the coarse outer bran removed. It cooks into an ultra-smooth, velvety porridge delivering 50% of daily iron (vital for anemia in IBD) with only 1g of gentle soluble fiber. Melts down effortlessly in gastric acid.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook on stovetop for 2.5 minutes. Swirl in a teaspoon of brown sugar, pure maple syrup, or a dash of cinnamon.
watchOuts: Contains wheat (gluten); choose Cream of Rice if co-diagnosed with celiac disease.
